name: Tinkers' Court
summary: In Gnomeregan's heart, Tinkers' Court once brought the city's leaders together. Now Mekgineer Thermaplugg holds the chamber.

sections.title: Seat of the Gnomish Council
sections.body: Before disaster drove the gnomes from Gnomeregan, their leaders gathered in Tinkers' Court. High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque met there with advisors and master inventors, among them Tinkmaster Overspark. They debated new technology, governed civic matters, and guided gnomish society. Beyond the Engineering Labs and the Launch Bay, the chamber stood at the heart of gnomish government and invention.

sections.title: Thermaplugg's Throneroom
sections.body: After radiation drove the gnomes into exile, Mekgineer Thermaplugg claimed Tinkers' Court. He calls himself King of Gnomeregan and sits among twisted contraptions, loyal leper gnomes, and bomb dispensers. From the chamber, he directs his remaining forces. Anyone seeking to end his rule must face this final and dangerous threshold.

faq.q: What was the Tinkers' Court used for originally?
faq.answer: Tinkers' Court was the meeting hall and civic chamber of Gnomeregan's High Tinker and ruling council. Gelbin Mekkatorque and advisors such as Tinkmaster Overspark gathered there to govern and discuss new inventions.
Mekgineer Thermaplugg controls Tinkers' Court. He calls himself King of Gnomeregan and holds the chamber with defensive machinery and irradiated minions.

faq.q: Where is the court located within Gnomeregan?
aliases: how to get to tinkers court
faq.answer: Tinkers' Court lies deep within Gnomeregan, beyond the dark tunnels and lower levels connected to the Launch Bay and Engineering Labs.

faq.q: Why is reaching Tinkers' Court so important for the Alliance?
faq.answer: Mekgineer Thermaplugg directs his irradiated minions from Tinkers' Court. Reaching him is the first step toward freeing Gnomeregan from his rule.

angles.text: As a gnome, Tinkers' Court recalls betrayal. Gnomish leaders once gathered here, before Mekgineer Thermaplugg seized the chamber amid irradiated ruin.
As an engineer, Tinkers' Court shows engineering turned deadly, with bomb delivery systems and the siege suit Thermaplugg operates.
